approaches.approach: Create duplicate tracing/eval systems instead of extending existing RAG infrastructure
approaches.why_failed_or_rejected: Splits the source of truth and increases instrumentation drift.
approaches.do_not_repeat: Extend conversation tracing/eval store unless a documented limitation requires replacement.
revisit_if: A focused spike proves the existing trace cannot carry bounded structured retrieval lineage.

approaches.approach: Add services/frameworks solely for portfolio buzzwords
approaches.why_failed_or_rejected: Adds operational complexity without demonstrated value.
approaches.do_not_repeat: Require a concrete use case, alternatives and acceptance/measurement criteria.

approaches.approach: Use production Top-K as eval candidate depth for Recall@10/20
approaches.why_failed_or_rejected: Metrics cannot observe ranks never retrieved.
approaches.do_not_repeat: Keep eval candidate depth separate and >= max reported K.
